method.data: Stage19 complete-strict auxiliary and three full-volume scalar controls; independent chain identities
method.assumptions: four chains independent and drawn from same stationary equilibrium distribution; nonstationarity and finite effective sample remain possible
method.cross_chain: E[xy] - average_{c != d}(mu_c * mu_d), exactly separates vacuum estimates by independent chains
method.cross_chain_unbiasedness: For independent stationary chains with common mean, cross-chain disconnected estimator is unbiased even with within-chain autocorrelation. Ensemble product estimator also unbiased under stationarity.
method.bootstrap: circular moving block within each chain; resampling joint per-configuration means and products; does not establish thermalization
method.scientific_gate: three consecutive positive 2 SE points t=2..6 in same channel across all bootstrap blocks 10,20,40,80; not mass alone
